local_evidence_note: Original sources, providers, logs, failure cases, live probes, reviews and control records stay under.cache. No vendor model, weight, data payload, tool log or generated build database is included.

method.control: One existing fabric; row/group ownership retained through real result acknowledgement, explicit strip ownership, held read bursts through true LAST, held KEEP/completion tuples, reset-only quarantine for unowned or partial predictor work.
method.local_choices: Numeric prediction thresholds and scalar quantization format are local choices; exact paper thresholds and full implementation are undisclosed. This row does not establish the paper aggregate45percent latency or57percent memory-access reductions.
method.margin: twice matching outlier signs minus outlier count
method.outlier_bits: Exact strict three-sigma input-space mask from acknowledged normalization transfers; preserve pre-gamma outlier sign separately from full normalized sign.
method.paper_reference: Tri-Oracle Figure31.6.5: normalized-input three-sigma outliers, pre-gamma activation signs, aligned weight signs, strip-wise sign estimates and intersected gate/up near-zero masks.
method.weight_signs: Negative iff the actual scalar per-tensor signed8 code is below zero; a zero weight has positive sign.

notation.ACK: Acknowledgement of an accepted memory or result transfer.
notation.KEEP: Per-channel mask bit requesting real feed-forward computation.
notation.LAST: Final accepted item of the actual owned burst or group.
notation.RAM: Random-access memory; the621 counted instances are outer vendor static-memory macros.
